stepNotes.1: Confirmed the sole exported gate, its four non-authenticated screens, and live placement around both the main app and Electron mini-chat roots.
stepNotes.2: Followed password and trust-device inputs through cookie-bearing session and passkey requests into server-side verification and TTL selection.
stepNotes.3: Traced every session response and password/passkey success or failure into the five-state gate, including the protected-child render invariant.
stepNotes.4: Checked concurrent startup requests, effect cleanup, passkey busy-state finalizers, once-per-unlock preference resync, and absence of polling or retained timers.
stepNotes.5: Verified that the component owns UI orchestration while the passkey library owns WebAuthn exchanges, with provider placement satisfying theme and i18n dependencies.
stepNotes.6: Reviewed all fallback catches, the fixed-false bypass scaffolding, focus restoration, error relationships, and the icon-only submit label.
stepNotes.7: Established that passkey route normalization and server secret safety are tested but the gate's render/state transitions have no direct component regression suite.
stepNotes.8: Reconciled the empty finding register with the inspected evidence, retained only non-blocking test/scaffolding observations, and found no Critical trigger.
stepNotes.9: Recorded 226 UI test files and 1,411 tests passing plus a successful UI TypeScript check, then completed a final evidence reread.
